EmailTemplate.name: QTP-Reporting a Workers' Compensation Injury
EmailTemplate.subject: Reporting a Worker's Compensation Injury
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [client]
There may come a time when you will need to report a job-related accident or injury. I wanted you to have the information you need in advance of any unfortunate situation. The following steps should be taken to report the injury and begin a Workers Compensation claim. Please reach out if you have questions about this process.
Reporting a Job-Related Accident or Injury
Report all injuries to Sedgwick at 866-863-6522 within 24 hours to avoid state-assessed fines. Report fatalities immediately to Sedgwick at 866-863-5622, Insperity at 281-348-3930 and OSHA at 1-800=321-6742 within 8 hours. Report severe injuries (in-patient hospitalization, amputation, or eye loss) within 24 hours.
Steps for reporting a claim:
Determine if your state has any specific requirements. If you are located in North Dakota, Ohio, Washington, or Wyoming, you are located in a monopolistic state. If you are in Minnesota or Tennessee, you must follow specific requirements. To review these requirements, please visit this page.
Fill out the First Report of Injury Workers Compensation Notification (attached above)
Choose one of the following reporting methods:For additional information on OSHA reporting click here.
For assistance in finding a Workers Comp Provider, click here.
You are welcome to connect directly with Insperity's Workers Compensation team at workerscompclaims@insperity.com with specific questions.
Thank you,
[signature]
